editorial: Artificial intelligence agents (AI agents) and browser-based automation tools have gained dominant momentum in software development processes today. Protocols that work especially integrated with developer tools create a new standard that focuses on increasing efficiency in code writing processes.

items.title: openai/codex-plugin-cc
items.summary: Developed by OpenAI, the Codex plugin allows code review processes and task delegation via Claude Code. This integration aims to increase efficiency by combining the capabilities of different artificial intelligence models in software development workflows.

items.title: JuliusBrussee/caveman
items.summary: Caveman is a capability package used on Claude Code that simplifies the language structure and reduces token usage by 65 percent. This tool aims to reduce transaction costs by allowing artificial intelligence models to communicate with less data.

items.title: alibaba/page-agent
items.summary: Developed by Alibaba, page-agent is a graphical user interface (GUI) agent that allows controlling web interfaces using natural language commands. Written in TypeScript, this tool aims to manage interactive elements on web pages through natural language processing.

items.title: usestrix/strix
items.summary: Strix is ​​an open source artificial intelligence-supported penetration testing tool developed to detect and fix security vulnerabilities in applications. This tool, written in Python language, aims to speed up vulnerability scanning processes by automating software security.

items.title: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
items.summary: Developed for Chrome DevTools, this server enables coding-focused artificial intelligence agents to manage in-browser debugging and review processes. It allows agents to interact with web pages and directly process technical data through the Model Context Protocol.

items.title: Zackriya-Solutions/meetily
items.summary: Meetily is an open source meeting assistant that processes meeting recordings locally and does not require a cloud connection. Developed in Rust, the application offers fast voice transcription, speaker diarization and summarization capabilities with local language models.

items.title: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks
items.summary: System prompts of popular major language models are compiled in a central repository for security research and analysis of model behavior. This resource makes transparently available the basic configuration instructions that developers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and xAI apply to their models.

items.title: harvard-edge/cs249r_book
items.summary: This resource, prepared by Harvard University, offers a comprehensive technical guide on machine learning systems. It details the development processes of scalable artificial intelligence models, focusing on the interaction between hardware and software.

items.title: rommapp/romm
items.summary: Romm is a self-hosted game archive manager developed for organizing game libraries and playing through the browser. Written in Python, this platform offers a visually oriented interface for managing digital game collections.

items.title: ogulcancelik/herdr
items.summary: Developed with the Rust language, herdr functions as an agent multiplexer that allows managing multiple artificial intelligence agents simultaneously on the terminal. It allows users to interact with different artificial intelligence models simultaneously via the command line.

items.title: dotnet/skills
items.summary: Developed for .NET and C#-based artificial intelligence coding agents, this library offers specialized skill packages that support software development processes. It allows developers to standardize automation tools and execute coding tasks efficiently.

items.title: agentskills/agentskills
items.summary: Agent Skills provides a standard framework (specification) for defining and documenting the capabilities of artificial intelligence agents. This structure aims to facilitate capability sharing and interoperability between different agent systems.

items.title: immich-app/immich
items.summary: Immich is a high-performance self-hosted media management solution developed to manage photo and video files. Written in TypeScript, this platform allows users to create a central media archive on their own infrastructure.

items.title: chthollyphile/folia-major
items.summary: Folia-major is a player interface that provides visualized lyric animations for local music files and online platforms. Developed with TypeScript, this tool aims to enrich the music listening experience with dynamic visual effects.

items.title: mattpocock/skills
items.summary: This repository, shared by Matt Pocock, brings together the scripts and skill packages used by software developers in artificial intelligence-supported coding tools. Developers can use these optimized ready-made configurations to improve the performance of generative AI models on platforms like Claude.

items.title: CoplayDev/unity-mcp
items.summary: Unity MCP provides a bridge between large language models and the Unity editor, allowing asset management, scene control and code editing processes to be automated. This tool, which works through the Model Server Protocol (Model Context Protocol), allows artificial intelligence assistants to directly intervene in game development workflows.

items.title: alirezarezvani/claude-skills
items.summary: Developed for Claude Code and various coding agents, this library offers more than 330 skill packages and over 70 special commands in different fields from engineering to marketing. This Python-based toolset provides customizable scripts to standardize AI-based workflows and increase productivity.

items.title: crynta/terax-ai
items.summary: Terax-ai, as a terminal-oriented artificial intelligence local development environment (AI-native dev workspace), attracts attention with its low size structure of 7 megabytes. Developed with TypeScript, this tool offers developers the opportunity to code with artificial intelligence directly via the terminal.

items.title: Leaking YouTube creators' private videos
items.summary: It has been determined that private videos on YouTube have become accessible to unauthorized persons due to a security vulnerability in the platform's interface. This situation leads to the leakage of video files, which are kept secret by content producers, through their metadata.

items.title: Command and Conquer Generals natively ported to macOS, iPhone, iPad using Fable
items.summary: The open source project, developed using the Fable engine, makes the Command and Conquer Generals game natively executable on macOS, iPhone and iPad devices. This work enables old strategy games to be played on modern Apple hardware without the need for an additional emulation layer.

items.title: Google Books (or similar) all book scans – $200k bounty (2025)
items.summary: Anna's Archive platform has launched a $200,000 bounty program to create a comprehensive digital library containing all scanned book data from Google Books and similar sources. This initiative aims to collect copyrighted or accessible works in a central data set.

items.title: Potential session/cache leakage between workspace instances or consumer accounts
items.summary: Claude Code users are reporting session or cache leakage between different workspace instances or consumer accounts. This indicates a technical weakness that may pose a data security risk between independent sessions.

items.title: GPT-5.5 Codex reasoning-token clustering may be leading to degraded performance
items.summary: It is argued that the reasoning-token clustering method in OpenAI models leads to a decrease in model performance in some cases. Users state that this clustering strategy increases the margin of error in code generation processes.

items.title: empero-ai/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M-GGUF
items.summary: Qwythos-9B, developed by Empero-ai, is a multimodal model that produces text output by processing visual and text data. The model is designed to optimize complex image and text analysis processes with high context window support.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.2
items.summary: GLM-5.2, developed by Zai-org, is a language model optimized for text generation tasks. This model, which has attracted high interest on the Hugging Face platform, offers content creation capabilities in natural language processing processes.

items.title: baidu/Unlimited-OCR
items.summary: Developed by Baidu, Unlimited-OCR is an image-to-text model that processes visual texts and produces text output. It is designed to automate the process of converting data from complex documents into digital format.

items.title: deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-35B-GGUF
items.summary: Ornith-1.0-35B, developed by Deepreinforce-ai, is a language model designed for text generation. The model can be run efficiently on different hardware configurations thanks to the GGUF format.

items.title: nvidia/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4
items.summary: Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 by Nvidia is a language model optimized for text-generation tasks. Trained with four-bit floating point (FP4) precision, this model supports high-performance inference processes.

Standard method for securely connecting AI models to different data sources and applications.
The process of transcribing voice recordings or conversations into text.
The process of determining who spoke when by distinguishing which person's voice in the audio recording came from.

Computer systems that learn on their own by analyzing data and can make more accurate decisions over time.
A method of running software on your own computer or private server rather than on another company's server.
